replies.bin is a 568-byte table extracted without changes from reply_message in:
https://github.com/FDH2/UxPlay/blob/15a6b87172eca38b0df4e615fbf1bba108734dde/lib/fairplay_playfair.c

Only the fixed reply bytes are used. The source's unchecked mode-indexing
function is not compiled or called. Rust verifies exact lengths, stages,
versions, and mode range before accessing the table.
